clause: 3D material and geometry options are property groups on the layer
spec_anchor_status: RESOLVED: derived from the assembled Master Spec module, not provisional

scope.summary: 3D material and geometry options are property groups on the layer**, not renderer settings. The recovered material members are: accepts lights, accepts shadows, casts shadows, appears in reflections, light transmission, ambient coefficient, diffuse coefficient, specular coefficient (intensity), specular shininess, metal coefficient, reflection coefficient, glossiness coefficient, fresnel coefficient, index of refraction, transparency coefficient, transparency rolloff, and shadow colour. The recovered geometry members are: extrusion depth, bevel depth, bevel style, bevel direction, plane curvature and plane subdivision. Every one is keyframable. Which of them a renderer honours is the renderer's declaration ([STU-CMP-060]), and a property that the active renderer ignores MUST be shown as inactive with a stated reason, never hidden.
scope.spec_text_is_authority: The clause text above is quoted from the Master Spec. Where this contract and the spec differ, the spec wins and this contract is regenerated.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Which of them a renderer honours is the renderer's declaration ([STU-CMP-060]), and a property that the active renderer ignores MUST be shown as inactive with a stated reason, never hidden.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
